source: Second, “attention is memory-bound” is too broad. The dominant bottleneck depends on sequence length, head dimension, precision, hardware, forward versus backward, and prefill versus decode. A memory hierarchy tells us where costs can arise. It does not let us label every attention workload with one bottleneck.
zh: 其次，“注意力受记忆限制”过于宽泛。主要瓶颈取决于序列长度、头部尺寸、精度、硬件、前向与后向以及预填充与解码。 A memory hierarchy tells us where costs can arise.它不允许我们为每一个注意力工作负载贴上一个瓶颈标签。
